exact_missing_items: route activation overrides remembered state only when required to satisfy the requested destination/object/context; otherwise it should reuse persisted shell state and local destination defaults

MUST override: target object identity; destination surface when the action explicitly names a different surface; scope required to make the target meaningful (project_id, thread_id, focused_run_id, or an explicitly requested panel/tab)
MUST NOT reuse persisted state when doing so would: land on the wrong object; hide the requested target behind the wrong tab/subview; silently keep the user on a stale run/thread/project context
Add a shared route-activation override rule in the contract/GUI owner docs.
Formalize the three-way command taxonomy: pure shell/view-state commands; route-consuming navigation commands; domain mutation/runtime commands
Keep `cmd.panel.switch` and `cmd.source_control.switch_subview` as pure shell/view-state commands with controlled destination vocabularies.
Move object-targeting payload semantics out of `cmd.panel.switch` and into canonical route-consuming commands or normalized `route_target` wrappers.
Define `route_target` as the canonical navigation-and-focus contract.
Define `OpenSubject` as the canonical identity-native source-open contract.
Keep `OpenFile` as the path-based editor contract only.
